text: Look out the window! Captain, look out your window! That's Lumi, a baby star whale. She swam off chasing comets and can't find her family. I'm Ranger Kai. Can you help?
A trail of stardust. Star whales leave trails of glowing stardust. Lumi's family left clues on planets across the galaxy. Each clue says where to go next.
Follow the clues. Read the clue, find the planet on your star map, and Lumi will follow your ship. Stuck? Tap Show me, and I'll light it up.
Together again. There they are! Lumi's whole family, singing so deep the planets hum. Lumi zooms straight into a giant hug with her mum.
A glowing gift. The star whales left you a gift, a tiny whale made of starlight that shimmers when you're near. And here's a reward from the Ranger Service. Well done!
